title: Visibility Shield: per-tenant projection & masking layer for usage streams
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Problem: Console usage endpoints serve a mix of high-cardinality event streams and aggregated views. Today some queries leak columns or aggregations that downstream UI teams expect to be filtered by team/role entitlements, and long-running heavy queries bypass the entitlement cache causing spikes in runtime. Goal: add a 'Visibility Shield' layer that projects and masks usage data per-tenant and per-role before it reaches console consumers or external export pipelines while preserving latency SLOs.

Scope: 1) Query-time predicate projection based on entitlement graph and attribute rules. 2) Result-level scrubbing for sensitive fields (e.g., user_id, session_token) with configurable redaction or hashing. 3) Delegation windows: support time-limited view delegation tokens for audit teams. 4) Aggregation-aware masking: ensure pre-aggregation filters are applied to avoid post-aggregation leakage. 5) Low-latency path: cache entitlements and compile query rewrites for hot dashboards to maintain 200ms median for simple metrics.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: full migration of historical exports, long-tail offline joins (handled by follow-up batch scrub job).
acceptance_criteria: Requests to /usage/console/* are routed through Visibility Shield and return identical shape to callers when entitlements allow
Unauthorized rows/fields are reliably removed or redacted for users without entitlement (verified by automated tests)
Key dashboards (Top Routes, Token Spend, Model Latency) maintain <=20% p50 increase in latency and p99 under 1.2s after shielding enabled
Audit log entries are emitted for every shield decision with reason, resolver version, and cache hit/miss
Delegation token flow supports TTL and revocation; revocation observable via admin console
implementation_notes: Introduce a new microservice 'visibility-shield' between query-gateway and analytics-store; service exposes rewrite API and result-scrubber endpoint
Entitlement evaluation reuses the fast in-memory entitlement cache from ENG-92010; add a small projection cache keyed by (tenant, query-signature) to speed repeated dashboard queries
Use query rewrite for supported stores (Presto/Trino, ClickHouse): add WHERE clauses and column lists; fallback to result-scrubbing for opaque connectors
For heavy aggregation endpoints, add an option to produce materialized pre-filtered aggregates (background job) to avoid runtime joins
Add feature flag console.visibility_shield.v1 to enable gradual rollout per-organization
Provide a debug header X-Visibility-Shield-Debug when request comes from internal admin token for troubleshooting (logs redacted in prod)
